## Details

Startup decodes the kernel stack and invokes the application once. Invalid required process
facts exit with status 127. Application return becomes the exit_group status.

## Gotchas

This composition provides no suspension storage or terminal report provider. It requires a
synchronous application closure. Fatal traps do not guarantee cleanup or a report.
